name: tts-cpp
description: Text-to-speech in pure C++/ggml: Resemble Chatterbox (Turbo + Multilingual), Supertonic, Fun-CosyVoice3, Parler-TTS, Audio8 (CPU + Metal / Vulkan / OpenCL GPU; Audio8 CPU-only), and LavaSR speech enhancement. Sourced from tetherto/qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp (engines/tts). This republish advances the pin to master 09566de3 and adds Audio8 (PR #128), a DualAR zero-shot model: a Qwen2.5-shaped 24-layer AR emits one semantic token per 21.5 Hz frame, a 4-layer fast AR expands each into the frame's remaining nine codebooks, and a DAC-style codec synthesises 44.1 kHz audio. Text to speech and voice cloning both run in-process, since the codec's analysis half turns a reference wav into codes without a Python side-car, and it ships as three GGUFs (language model, codec decoder, codec encoder) so a text-only deployment can omit the encoder. The codec runs in blocks in both directions, which keeps memory flat in utterance length (a 24 s decode: 1.5 GB of arena down to ~150 MB), and a cancel is honoured at the next language model step or codec block. New engine only, so nothing existing changes shape and the ggml-speech floor stays at 2026-08-07; whisper-cpp, parakeet-cpp and audiogen-cpp stay on the 5e57a692 archive, whose library sources are byte-identical to this one.
